# game/main_loop.asm: Game start, life start and main loop

Range `$4140-$41F2`. Source: [game/main_loop.asm](../../../../src/game/main_loop.asm). Index: [the reference](../../index.md).

## Names

<a id="game_start"></a>
### [`game_start`](../../../../src/game/main_loop.asm#L6) `$4140`

*label*

Start of a game: 3 jets. The code from game_new_life sets up the screen for each jet, then the main loop runs until the jet is lost.

- **Jumped to from:** [`$41F0`](../../../../src/game/main_loop.asm#L102)

<a id="game_new_life"></a>
### [`game_new_life`](../../../../src/game/main_loop.asm#L10) `$4144`

*label*

Start of each jet: draws the game screen and the panel, and sets the sprites and the landscape.

- **Jumped to from:** [`$41DA`](../../../../src/game/main_loop.asm#L89)

<a id="main_loop"></a>
### [`main_loop`](../../../../src/game/main_loop.asm#L54) `$4185`

*label*

One pass of the game. It starts CIA 2 timer B ($7fxx cycles, one-shot), calls the game routines, then waits for the end of the timer count.

- **Jumped to from:** [`$41CB`](../../../../src/game/main_loop.asm#L82), [`$41D4`](../../../../src/game/main_loop.asm#L86)

<a id="main_loop_wait_timer"></a>
### [`main_loop_wait_timer`](../../../../src/game/main_loop.asm#L76) `$41C0`

*label*

The timer stops at the end of the count and reloads the high byte $7f.

- **Jumped to from:** [`$41C5`](../../../../src/game/main_loop.asm#L79)
